title: 第十九章技艺突破实力提升第二十章刀法小成
content_zh:
;;
站在木桩面前。
江宁又握起柴刀，将一块厚实的圆木放置在木桩上。
就在他正准备劈砍之时，耳边顿时传来一道洪亮的声音。
“小家伙，晚饭好了，快来吃饭啦！！”
“好的，大姐！”江宁抬头应了一句。
厨房中，端着托盘的孙大娘不由的嘴角微扬。
“这小家伙的嘴巴可真甜！再加上这张俊俏的脸，以后去哄女孩子肯定手到擒来！”
另一边。
江宁抬头回应了孙大娘一声。
依旧握紧手中的柴刀。
下一刻。
手臂肌肉瞬间暴起。
嗖——
刀刃划过空气传来细微的摩擦声。
咔嚓——
随着柴刀落下，厚实的圆木瞬间传来裂开的声音。
江宁看着身前柴刀劈开的痕迹，眼神微微一凝。
“入木十之八九！果然不一样了！”
他脸上缓缓露出一抹笑容，然后手掌发力，柴刀厚重的刀身在木材断口中横卧。

咔咔——
身前的木材传来不断木材纤维撕裂的声音。
最后，在柴刀厚重的刀身撬动下，整块木材被他成功的分开，一分为二的圆木下方呈现不规则的撕裂痕迹。
【劈柴刀法经验值+1】
“刚刚全力一刀下去，只能入木十之五六，如今劈柴刀法突破至精通，却能入木十之八九，果然变强了！”
江宁满意的点点头，如此短暂的时间进步如此之大，让他极其满意。
随后他将柴刀放在一旁，朝着孙大娘离去的方向走去。
......
踏入主厅。
“师父！！”
“坐！”王进停下手中的动作，朝着江宁示意。
“多谢师父！！”江宁躬身行礼。
待江宁入座后，一碗飘着浓郁香味的肉羹被孙大娘放在他的眼前。
content_en:

Stand in front of the stake.
Jiang Ning picked up the hatchet again and placed a thick log on the stake.
Just when he was about to chop, a loud voice suddenly came to his ears.
"Little guy, dinner is ready, come and eat!!"
"Okay, eldest sister!" Jiang Ning raised her head and responded.
In the kitchen, Aunt Sun, who was holding a tray, could not help but raise the corners of her mouth.
"This little guy has such a sweet mouth! Coupled with this handsome face, he will definitely be able to coax girls in the future!"
other side.
Jiang Ning raised his head and responded to Aunt Sun.
Still holding the hatchet in his hand tightly.
The next moment.
The arm muscles suddenly bulged.
Whoosh——
There was a slight friction sound as the blade cut through the air.
Click——
As the hatchet fell, the thick log cracked instantly.
Jiang Ning looked at the marks of the hatchet in front of him and his eyes narrowed slightly.
"It's 90% likely! It's really different!"
A smile slowly appeared on his face, and then he exerted force with his palm, and the thick blade of the hatchet lay horizontally in the fracture of the wood.
Kaka——
There was a constant sound of wood fibers tearing from the wood in front of him.
Finally, with the heavy blade of the hatchet, he successfully separated the entire piece of wood. There were irregular tear marks underneath the bisected log.
[Experience value +1 for splitting knife method]
"Just now, when I slashed with all my strength, I could only penetrate 50-60% of the wood. Now that I have achieved proficiency in wood chopping skills, I can only penetrate 89% of the time. I have really become stronger!"
Jiang Ning nodded with satisfaction. He was extremely satisfied with the progress he had made in such a short period of time.
Then he put the hatchet aside and walked in the direction where Aunt Sun left.
...
Enter the main hall.
"Master!!"
"Sit!" Wang Jin stopped what he was doing and gestured towards Jiang Ning.
"Thank you, Master!!" Jiang Ning bowed and saluted.
After Jiang Ning took his seat, Aunt Sun placed a bowl of meat soup in front of him.
